description: Self-improvement (the repo's established resolver convention: each issue-resolving run must also improve the resolver's own mechanisms; see .kiro/agents/github-issue-resolver.md 主要機能 2〜4). Retrospective focus: WHY do the same issues (especially the AWS-backend ones #32 leaderboard, #162 account-free posting, #167 feedback analytics) keep coming back and consuming re-triage effort every run? Add a DURABLE, human-maintained index of issues that are permanently blocked on human/AWS action, so future runs recognize them as blocked WITHOUT re-reading and re-reasoning about each from scratch, and record the retrospective. This is a SEPARATE chore branch/PR — it MUST NOT be mixed with the #209 feature branch. It only adds/strengthens conventions and documentation; it does NOT weaken any existing constraint (AWS-operation ban, no-push-to-main, no force-push, no secrets) and performs NO aws commands and NO gh writes.
steps: Create the chore branch from the latest main (NOT from the #209 branch): `git switch main` then `git switch -c chore/issue-resolver-blocked-issues-index`. All FEAT-003 work happens here. Do NOT push.

Read docs/wiki/issue-resolution-playbook.md and docs/wiki/efficiency-log.md and docs/wiki/README.md to match their existing schema (leading metadata block + trailing `## 更新履歴`) and Japanese tone. Read the 'agent:skipped' / SKIP / RECHECK運用 section of .kiro/agents/github-issue-resolver.md so the new index is consistent with (and references) the existing marker mechanism rather than duplicating or contradicting it.

Create docs/wiki/blocked-issues-index.md: a durable, human-reviewable index of open issues that are structurally blocked on human/AWS action and therefore should NOT be re-triaged from scratch each run. For each entry record: issue number + title, blocker category (要人間対応: AWS backend / 情報不足 / etc.), a one-line why-it-is-blocked, what human action would unblock it (e.g. 'AWS: DynamoDB + Lambda + API Gateway provisioning for a global leaderboard'), and a pointer to any docs/action-required/ artifact. Seed it with the currently-known permanently-blocked AWS-backend issues from this run's triage: #32 (global leaderboard — DynamoDB+Lambda+API Gateway), #162 (account-free issue posting — Lambda proxy), #167 (feedback analytics — Lambda→DynamoDB pipeline + QuickSight). Follow the wiki page schema (metadata block at top, `## 更新履歴` at bottom). Make clear this index is the single durable place a run consults FIRST to skip re-reasoning, complementing (not replacing) the `agent:skipped` GitHub label mechanism.

Add a short pointer in .kiro/agents/github-issue-resolver.md so future runs actually consult the new index: in the triage/棚卸し section (near the `agent:skipped` marker運用 or 手順 3), add a sentence instructing the agent to read docs/wiki/blocked-issues-index.md FIRST and skip re-triaging its listed issues unless the issue has new human input since the recorded date. Do NOT delete or weaken any existing rule; this is an additive gate (制約の追加・明確化). Keep the wording consistent with the existing '止まらず前進する' / SKIP・RECHECK vocabulary.

Add a dated retrospective entry to docs/wiki/efficiency-log.md (match the existing entry format and update its `最終更新日` and `## 更新履歴`). Content: root cause = there was no single durable list of permanently-blocked issues, so every run re-derived the same 'AWS backend required → skip' conclusion for #32/#162/#167 (visible as repeated 🤖 agent:skipped churn on #32); the fix = a durable blocked-issues index + a prompt gate to consult it first; expected effect = fewer tokens/less repeated reasoning on known-blocked issues; risk = none (additive docs + convention, no constraint weakened, no permissions loosened).

If docs/wiki/blocked-issues-index.md is a NEW wiki page, update docs/wiki/README.md '現在のページ一覧' AND the docs index docs/index.md in this SAME commit so there are no dead links / orphaned files (the wiki運用ルール requires this).

Static verification: there is no JS in this feature, but confirm no accidental JS/JSON breakage: `git status --short` shows only the intended docs/.kiro files; run a markdown sanity read of each changed file. Confirm the PR-body draft and this doc contain NO GitHub task-list checkbox syntax (`- [ ]`).

Commit on chore/issue-resolver-blocked-issues-index with a Japanese conventional-commit message, e.g. `chore: 人間/AWS対応待ちで恒久ブロック中のissue索引を追加し再トリアージの重複を削減 (#32, #162, #167)`. Stage only the specific changed files (docs/wiki/blocked-issues-index.md, docs/wiki/README.md, docs/wiki/efficiency-log.md, docs/index.md, .kiro/agents/github-issue-resolver.md) — no `git add -A`. Do NOT push. Do NOT open a PR.
acceptance_criteria: A separate branch chore/issue-resolver-blocked-issues-index exists, created from main, containing ONLY the self-improvement changes (no #209 code).
docs/wiki/blocked-issues-index.md exists, follows the wiki page schema (metadata block + 更新履歴), and seeds #32, #162, #167 with blocker category, why, and the human/AWS action needed.
.kiro/agents/github-issue-resolver.md instructs future runs to consult docs/wiki/blocked-issues-index.md first, as an ADDITIVE gate that weakens no existing constraint.
docs/wiki/efficiency-log.md has a new dated retrospective entry (with 最終更新日 / 更新履歴 updated) explaining root cause, fix, expected effect, and 'no constraint weakened'.
docs/wiki/README.md page list and docs/index.md are updated in the same commit (no dead links / no orphaned page).
No `- [ ]` / `- [x]` GitHub task-list syntax appears in the PR body draft or docs; no aws commands or gh writes were performed.
Changes are committed on the chore branch and NOT pushed; the #209 feature branch is untouched by this feature.
verification: git status --short  # expect clean after commit; only intended files were changed
git log --oneline -1  # confirm the chore commit message references #32/#162/#167
grep -RIn -- '- \[ \]' docs/wiki/blocked-issues-index.md docs/wiki/efficiency-log.md || echo 'no task-list checkboxes (good)'
